newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy June cumulative PSBR 52.250 trillion lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy June cumulative PSBR 52.250 trillion lire.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was 52.250 trillion lire at end-June 1996 compared with 49.382 trillion in June 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.

Receipts totalled 255.505 trillion lire over the period against expenditure of 295.552 trillion, but this gap was partially widened by a net deficit on Treasury management operations of 12.203 trillion.
Medium- and long-term domestic borrowing over the period raised 67.530 trillion, while 4.526 trillion was raised on international markets.
The volume of short-term Treasury bills in circulation fell 7.751 trillion lire to 404.263 trillion at end-June from 412.014 trillion at end-December 1995.
